invariants.I01: Every user need has an explicit terminal result; fields do not define the need set
invariants.I02: No supported derived claim has an unmet hard dependency
invariants.I03: Claims use authorized common facts or approved live observations, not legacy factual fallback
invariants.I04: Material qualifiers and explicit targets retain their meaning and binding
invariants.I05: Unknown is not false, closed, zero, free or allowed without evidence
invariants.I06: Complete lists require exhaustive scope receipts and stable pagination scope
invariants.I07: Ranking and model confidence do not override authority, applicability or validity
invariants.I08: Critical numbers, units, negation and exceptions survive normalization and localization
invariants.I09: State preserves intent references; facts are read again against current coherent snapshot
invariants.I10: Live mapping, freshness and observed_at are explicit; static data cannot replace live truth
invariants.I11: All branches share one deadline and attempt ledger
invariants.I12: Kind/task readiness is distinct from verified NLU and answer correctness
